subject: a frog face built from contrasting stone inlays
pose: frontal relief with slightly uneven eye domes
art_direction: 圆润蛙头像由不同石材嵌成，绿石眼隆起与粉色鼻面平衡，表情沉着有趣。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a frog face as a shallow polished-stone relief, using moss-green serpentine for the raised eye domes, dusty pink limestone for the broad muzzle, and pale travertine for a narrow lower edge. Give the eyes small dark inlaid pupils, one fractionally lower to create an unimpressed but endearing look. The mouth is a single thin curved seam between stone pieces. Render subtle mineral veins and tiny pores while keeping the overall shapes broad and quiet. Set the relief against a deep green matte field, with soft side light describing its shallow depth. The face fills three quarters of the square and fits naturally into a circular crop, without a surrounding medallion border.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
